title: Community pharmacy setting under 247 CMR 16.03(5) and 243 CMR 2.12(4)(e): current agreement, age and vaccines
rule_summary: 247 CMR 16.03 provides that, in accordance with M.G.L. c. 112, s. 24B1/2(c), collaborative drug therapy management may be performed in the listed settings by pharmacists meeting the requirements of 247 CMR 16.02(1) and authorized by a supervising physician pursuant to a current collaborative practice agreement. 247 CMR 16.03(5) lists Community Pharmacies (retail drug business settings) licensed by the Board pursuant to M.G.L. c. 112, s. 39, subject to the restrictions listed below it and pursuant to a current collaborative practice agreement that includes the following requirements: (a) Patient Age, patients must be 18 years of age or older; (b) Vaccine Administration, pharmacists, as authorized pursuant to a collaborative practice agreement, may administer vaccines; (c) Patient Referral and Consent; (d) Record of Referral and Consent; and (e) Limited Prescribing Authority. 243 CMR 2.12(4)(e)1. and 2. state the same age and vaccine items for the Board of Registration in Medicine.
exam_relevance: Tests that the regulations state the 18-year age floor and vaccine administration as separate items applying to a community pharmacy agreement, with vaccine administration stated without a disease-state list.

authority.name: Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations
Board of Registration in Medicine regulations

numeric_facts.fact: Minimum patient age in a community pharmacy collaborative practice agreement

common_confusions: The vaccine item in 247 CMR 16.03(5)(b) is stated on its own, not as part of the list of disease states in 247 CMR 16.03(5)(e)1.b.
The regulation describes the setting as a community pharmacy licensed by the Board under M.G.L. c. 112, s. 39; the statute describes a retail drug business as registered in section 38.
The age item sits among the requirements of the agreement for the setting; it is not confined to prescribing.
verification_notes: Read in the current mass.gov PDF of 247 CMR 16.00 (regulation page dated 12/15/2017) and in the current mass.gov PDF of 243 CMR 2.00 on 2026-09-17.
